data.gender_notes: Agan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Agan is derived from the root word 'aemos' which means breath or wind. This name signifies agility, quickness, and adaptability. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to the name Agan. The name Agan carries the meaning “Breath, Agility” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Agan usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, agility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the breath of life from God.
data.etymology: Agan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath, Agility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Agan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
